subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To sleep like a dog
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'To sleep soundly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct alternative** that best expresses the meaning of the idiom "To sleep like a dog" is **option 3) **To sleep soundly.(गहरी नींद सोना)
 
• **To be insomniac:** This option means to have difficulty sleeping or to suffer from insomnia.(अनिद्रा होना)
 
• **To make noise while sleeping:** This option suggests that the person is making noise while sleeping,(सोते समय आवाज़ करना)
 
• **To be less mindful:** This option implies being less aware or attentive(कम सतर्क होना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'To sleep soundly'.*
